installCommand: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
buildCommand: cd client && npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.join(__dirname,'dist'); const dest=path.join(__dirname,'../server/public'); fs.cpSync(src, dest, {recursive:true}); console.log('Copied client/dist to server/public')"
